title: Lab: build a reproducible developer workstation
description: Combine a versioned runtime, project manifest, lockfile, safe configuration, portable scripts and Git ignore rules into a complete clean-checkout verification exercise.
objectives: Assemble a project with a documented runtime and package manager
Check in portable editor settings and a dependency lock
Validate configuration and tests with one reproducible command
Prove a clean copy works without private credentials or cloud accounts
rubric: I assembled the runtime, manifest, lockfile and workspace contract.
I ran the capstone from a clean copy with safe configuration.
I documented setup and passed the end-to-end workstation acceptance tests.
